Update5 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
3rd Anniversary | Patch Notes
ArcheAge Classic is celebrating its 3rd Anniversary! Lots of events are getting enabled and more are coming.

🎉 ArcheAge Classic's 3rd Anniversary Celebration!

Happy 3rd Anniversary, everyone!

Thank you all for being part of ArcheAge Classic over the past three years. To celebrate the occasion, we've enabled a variety of special events and rewards throughout the anniversary period.

Anniversary Events

1. ⚔️ War Means War!

During the anniversary celebration, Faction PvP events will reward Brave Warrior's Medals instead of the standard Warrior's Medals.

Brave Warrior's Medals can be used to craft Unsealed Proven Warrior Necklaces up to Rank 11 (Epic).

These medals replace the usual rewards from:

  • Golden Plains Battle (Relic Holder)
  • Mistmerrow War (Point Rewards)
  • Veroe Victory Rewards
  • Great Heist (Releasing Later)

2. 🔥 Phoenix Ashes Return

Thinking about joining the adventure?

Phoenix Ashes have returned to the Divine Clock, giving both new and returning players a great opportunity to accelerate their early progression. Additional sources will be released tomorrow in Part 2.

3. 🌊 Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival

The Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival is now live!

From today through August 20, you'll be able to complete a variety of daily quests and earn festival rewards.

4. 🇽2️⃣ Double Event is Active!

Enjoy boosted rates throughout the celebration:

  • 🇽2️⃣ Experience (including Guild & Family EXP)
  • 🇽2️⃣ Honor, Vocation & Prestige
  • 🇽2️⃣ Cloak Synthesis Experience

🎁 Anniversary Goodie Boxes

The following quests and activities will reward Anniversary Goodie Boxes:

  • Crimson Omens I, II & III
  • Helping the War Effort
  • Halting the Crimson Tide I & II
  • Lusca Awakening
  • Hound of Kyrios
  • The Cursed Tower
  • The Battle of Mistmerrow Basin
  • Greater Bounty: Ancient Titan Musperosa
  • Bounty: Dahuta
  • Bounty: Sirothe the Infernal
  • Bounty: Recordkeeper Wynn
  • Bounty: Halnaak
  • Bounty: Rowan Alexander
  • Bounty: Captain Jergant
  • Greater Bounty: Arkanis the Destroyer
  • A Harsh Lesson
  • Anthalon's Elite
  • Aegis Island Guardian
  • Harvest Festival Warriors
  • An Eye for an Eye, a Pack for a Pack
  • Causing Mayhem in Veroe

👀 More Anniversary Events Begin Tomorrow

The celebration doesn't stop here!

Two additional anniversary events will begin tomorrow.

One of them is The Great Heist—a brand-new three-faction tug-of-war event taking place in Windscour, where Nuia, Haranya, and Pirate players will battle for control of a slow-moving freighter packed with valuable cargo.

Stay tuned for the full announcement tomorrow!

== 🎉 ArcheAge Classic's 3rd Anniversary Celebration! ==

Happy 3rd Anniversary, everyone!

Thank you all for being part of ArcheAge Classic over the past three years. To celebrate the occasion, we've enabled a variety of special events and rewards throughout the anniversary period.

== Anniversary Events ==

=== 1. ⚔️ War Means War! ===

During the anniversary celebration, Faction PvP events will reward '''Brave Warrior's Medals''' instead of the standard Warrior's Medals.

Brave Warrior's Medals can be used to craft '''Unsealed Proven Warrior Necklaces''' up to '''Rank 11 (Epic)'''.

These medals replace the usual rewards from:

* Golden Plains Battle (Relic Holder)
* Mistmerrow War (Point Rewards)
* Veroe Victory Rewards
* Great Heist (Releasing Later)

----

=== 2. 🔥 Phoenix Ashes Return ===

Thinking about joining the adventure?

'''Phoenix Ashes''' have returned to the '''Divine Clock''', giving both new and returning players a great opportunity to accelerate their early progression. Additional sources will be released tomorrow in Part 2.

----

=== 3. 🌊 Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival ===

The '''Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival''' is now live!

From '''today through August 20''', you'll be able to complete a variety of daily quests and earn festival rewards.

----

=== 4. 🇽2️⃣ Double Event is Active! ===

Enjoy boosted rates throughout the celebration:

* 🇽2️⃣ Experience (including Guild & Family EXP)
* 🇽2️⃣ Honor, Vocation & Prestige
* 🇽2️⃣ Cloak Synthesis Experience

----

== 🎁 Anniversary Goodie Boxes ==

The following quests and activities will reward '''Anniversary Goodie Boxes''':

* Crimson Omens I, II & III
* Helping the War Effort
* Halting the Crimson Tide I & II
* Lusca Awakening
* Hound of Kyrios
* The Cursed Tower
* The Battle of Mistmerrow Basin
* Greater Bounty: Ancient Titan Musperosa
* Bounty: Dahuta
* Bounty: Sirothe the Infernal
* Bounty: Recordkeeper Wynn
* Bounty: Halnaak
* Bounty: Rowan Alexander
* Bounty: Captain Jergant
* Greater Bounty: Arkanis the Destroyer
* A Harsh Lesson
* Anthalon's Elite
* Aegis Island Guardian
* Harvest Festival Warriors
* An Eye for an Eye, a Pack for a Pack
* Causing Mayhem in Veroe

----

== 👀 More Anniversary Events Begin Tomorrow ==

The celebration doesn't stop here!

'''Two additional anniversary events''' will begin tomorrow.

One of them is '''The Great Heist'''—a brand-new '''three-faction tug-of-war event''' taking place in '''Windscour''', where Nuia, Haranya, and Pirate players will battle for control of a slow-moving freighter packed with valuable cargo.

Stay tuned for the full announcement tomorrow!
